note: Re-judged 2026-10-31 by an independent auditor who authored none of the change. RFC text (rfc4271): "A BGP speaker SHALL calculate the degree of preference for each external route based on the locally-configured policy, and include the degree of preference when advertising a route to its internal peers." be95c10053 gave receiveExternalRoute an explicit import policy in both cases (FinalAccept, no refs, plus the set-local-pref ref in the policy case) and reworded the negative tag from 'no import policy' to 'an import policy that sets none'; faf7c5c380 renamed filterapi to routepolicy in the same fixture. Under RFC 8212 a route with no import policy is ineligible and is never advertised, so the old negative input no longer reaches the decision; the reworded input keeps its point (nothing on the route names a degree of preference) and the assertions are unchanged: dispatched to the RIB with no LOCAL_PREF (never 200), advertised internally with the default 100. The tag now states the input the body drives. Verdict unchanged: enforced. Earlier judgements are in this file's git history.
